Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of TXN.
Our gross margin expanded by 110 basis points to 43.5%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 14% to 15% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2023.
We generated $5.9 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Thank you for the question. Our gross margin expanded by 110 basis points to 43.5%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Second question - Analyst:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 110 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
